title: C++ Code Intelligence for Copilot CLI in Public Preview
description: GitHub Copilot CLI now supports C++ code intelligence in public preview, expanding language support for command-line development workflows.

title: GPT-5 Model Support
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models including GPT-5.1, GPT-5.2, and GPT-5-pro across OpenAI, Azure, and OpenRouter providers with chat and codex variants.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Generally Available
description: Claude Opus 4.7 is now generally available in GitHub Copilot, expanding model options for users.

title: Canvases - Interactive Visualizations
description: Cursor can now respond by creating interactive canvases with dashboards and custom interfaces built using first-party components like tables, boxes, diagrams, and charts. Canvases are durable artifacts in the Agents Window side panel.

title: Version 0.34.0 - UI Polish and Core Fixes
description: April 2026 release featuring UI polish improvements, core fixes, new tools integration, and chat resume footer on session functionality.

title: CLI Debug Mode and /btw Support
description: Quality-of-life improvements to Cursor CLI including /debug for root cause analysis, /btw for side questions without derailing tasks, and /config for interactive settings panel.

title: Model Selection for Claude and Codex Agents
description: Model selection improvements for Claude and Codex agents on github.com, giving users more control over AI model choices.

title: Copilot Data Residency with FedRAMP Compliance
description: Copilot now offers data residency in US + EU and FedRAMP compliance, addressing enterprise data governance requirements.

title: BYOK and Local Models Support in Copilot CLI
description: Copilot CLI now supports Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) and local models, giving developers flexibility in model deployment and cost management.

title: Copilot SDK in Public Preview
description: GitHub Copilot SDK is now in public preview, enabling developers to build custom integrations and extensions.

title: GPT-5.4 Mini in Copilot Student Auto Model Selection
description: GPT-5.4 mini is now available in Copilot Student auto model selection, providing more efficient model options for educational users.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent with Research and Planning
description: Copilot cloud agent can now research, plan, and code with improved capabilities. Remote control CLI sessions available in public preview on web and mobile.
